label: Inkling 2 Mini oQ4e (oMLX 0.8.1, M3 Ultra)

engine.name: omlx
engine.settings: temperature 1.0 (the pack's generation_config; no top_p/top_k advice, so top_p 1.0, top_k off, min_p 0), effort high, MTP, chunked prefill, aggressive burst decode

verify_before_runs: model_id and reasoning parameter accepted (smoke run shows reasoning tokens)
engine flags in record/host/start.txt match engine block
notes: Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Mini (Apache 2.0): a looped mixture-of-experts model, 26.4B total parameters, whose middle 12 of 24 layers run three times per token. oMLX 0.8.1 is the first oMLX release that loads it; production stayed on 0.8.0rc1, so this run used 0.8.1 installed beside it for probes. The chat template maps reasoning_effort high to its thinking-effort level 0.9, the template's default. mlx-community's oQ4e pack keeps the source NVFP4 experts for layers 0-19 and requantizes the rest. The exact request and response are in record/raw. Eiffel Tower: a first attempt (2026-11-21 05:42Z) was cut off after 68 model calls when the controller machine crashed; the agent had not finished, so it is not a result and is not listed. The published run is a fresh attempt with the same setup.
pack_label: mlx-community oQ4e + DSpark MTP draft (oMLX oQ)
